prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1459; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss from the insured. Sideswipe occurred during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane. Both vehicles drivable. Photos requested.

Entry 2: Contacted the other driver's carrier. Liability disputed; the other driver states the insured's vehicle was already partially in the adjacent lane. Scene diagram and witness statements requested.

Entry 3: Claimant is represented by counsel. All communication to be routed through the attorney's office going forward. Letter of representation on file. Claimant reports neck strain and is seeking medical evaluation.

Entry 4: Reviewed police report and photographs. Damage pattern is consistent with a glancing side contact along the rear quarter panel. Liability assessment pending receipt of the claimant's medical records and the attorney's demand package.

Entry 5: Attorney submitted demand for bodily injury treatment records and itemized bills. Records requested from the treating provider. Reserves reviewed and adjusted. File remains open pending medical review and liability determination.
